summary: The planning candidate faithfully encodes all five Owner directions and answers (1A, 2A, 3A, 4A, 5A) into the three FROZEN_FROM_BASELINE_6C31778 contracts (T011, T012, T013), drafts a new ADR-009 capturing the display / Decimal boundary decision with Status=Accepted and Date=2026-09-15, and adds the ADR-009 row to docs/spec/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md section 4 immediately after the ADR-008 row.
